title: Weak-Coupling Limit of the Lattice Nonlinear Schrödinger Integral Equation
summary: We study the ground-state integral equation of the quantum lattice nonlinear Schrödinger model, equivalently the isotropic Heisenberg XXX chain at spin $s = -1$, whose solution is the root density on a Fermi interval. In the weak-coupling limit the equation is doubly singular: the driving term and the kernel collapse onto delta functions, and the solution separates into three regions on three scales, an inner peak, the bulk of the Fermi sea, and a boundary layer at the band edge.
